retry_policy: as shipped: up to 3 attempts on 408, 429 and 5xx with backoff for a first ask; a re-ask is sent once; a request set aside is asked again at most 2 more times, each at least 300 s after its previous answer or attempt, each reserved at its worst case
stop_conditions: the stage's submission ceiling (the collector's own ceiling and the account-wide gate); store or fulfillment not verified on a page (STORE_NOT_VERIFIED); ABNORMAL_RESULT, SITE_REFUSAL or three pages in a row not read (PROVIDER_ERROR); a ledger refusal, or more than 2 outcomes left unknown; the stage deadline; by the operator: once 10 re-asks have been answered and none recovered its request, the stage is stopped and reported as it stands (no allowance is spent repeating one outcome)
passes_when: the run ends on its own (not by a ceiling or an operator stop) with G13 PASS and every page verified for 53100502 PICKUP; the Q5 measures recorded for comparison with L1
